newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Latam energy ministers open conference.
newsitem.headline: Latam energy ministers open conference.

text.p: Energy ministers from 25 Latin American countries on Thursday inaugurated the 27th meeting of the Latin American Energy Organization (OLADE) on Thursday, calling for technical cooperation and integration.

"At the close of this forum we should have the mechanisms to widen power coverage so that the entire population has equal access to energy, lowering costs, and keeping in mind, of course, environment concerns as well as development," Guatemalan Energy Minister Leonel Lopez at the opening of the two-day conference.

The nations of Latin America and the Caribbean produce 8.9 percent of the world's power, including petroleum, natural gas, nuclear energy and hydroelectric energy, and represent 6.7 percent of global energy consumption.
